comments.author: @PrimeTravel2
comments.text: Gabon is such an underrated country. The connection between people, rivers, and the surrounding rainforest is fascinating. There are so many places in Africa that deserve much more attention!

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: Completely agree, @PrimeTravel2! Gabon’s pristine river basin communities and vast rainforest canopy are truly the lungs of Africa. We’re so glad this documentary helped shine a light on its overlooked natural wonders!
